stock.description: Billion Industrial Holdings Limited, alongside its associated companies, specializes in the production and sale of various polyester-based materials, serving markets both within the People's Republic of China and internationally. Their product range includes polyester filament yarns, offered in forms such as drawn textured, fully drawn, and partially oriented, which are vital components for manufacturing fabrics and textiles used in apparel, footwear, and home furnishings. The company also supplies an extensive array of polyester thin films, encompassing heat sealable, twistable, anti-static, electronic releasing, coating, metallization, printing, transfer, electrical insulation, card lamination, hot stamping, metallic yarn, reflector, holographic, and solar base films. These films, together with other polyester products like biaxially-oriented polyethylene terephthalate films, polyester bottle chips, and recycled filament, are utilized across diverse industries including packaging, magnetic materials, imaging, general industry, electronics, and electrical appliances. Furthermore, Billion Industrial Holdings Limited provides polyester industrial yarns and ES fiber products. The company was established in 2003 and has its headquarters in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
